title: Presentation Framework And Projektetage Migration
description: Build @framework/presentation/core (declarative render-independent presentation model) + @framework/presentation/renderer/react (React+reveal.js). Migrate mit-bestand/präsentation/33.projektetage to eg-ice-25 intro (5 slides) with no direct react/reveal deps.
summary: Refactored presentation model: style-less participants/embodiments (content only); arrangements assign embodimentId, emphasis, morphRoot, fit, muteAuthorNames. DEFAULT_THOUGHT_TRANSITION morph drives reveal data-auto-animate on every arrangement. intro() uses place() helper with eg-ice-25 placement table. Renderer applies presentation from ResolvedPlacement only.
